steps.title: Setup Project Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with the application name 'Magic Spellbook' and package name 'com.magicspellbook.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Create the app/build.gradle script matching standard SDK 34 specifications, Gradle 8.5, and AGP 8.3.2 configuration.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with the correct namespace, launch intent filters, standard theme, and permissions like vibration.

steps.title: Define Color Resources
steps.description: Establish standard mystical themes in colors.xml using Deep Obsidian, Mystical Violet, Glowing Cyan, and Golden Amber.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Define textual content for magical spell descriptions, potion ingredients, Oracle answers, and UI instructions in strings.xml.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Magic View
steps.description: Implement MagicWandView.java, a custom drawing canvas that spawns sparkling, fading star particles on finger swipe using standard Canvas APIs.

steps.title: Design Mystic User Interface
steps.description: Develop activity_main.xml with a beautiful tab-based layout separating the Spellbook, Potion Brewer, and Oracle Room.

steps.title: Program Dynamic Sound Generator
steps.description: Develop a real-time native audio synthesizer in MainActivity using AudioTrack to create perfect magical pitch-sweeps programmatically.

steps.title: Implement Magic Oracle Logic
steps.description: Program the Interactive Magic Oracle inside MainActivity to respond to shaking motions and screen taps with animated fades and vibration.

steps.title: Program Potion Brewing Simulation
steps.description: Implement potion ingredient-mixing algorithm matching colors dynamically and unlocking unique potion results.

steps.title: Implement Gesture Shake Listener
steps.description: Connect the accelerometer sensor to detect wand swings/shakes, triggering screen flashes and magical sound sweeps.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Perform rigorous checks to ensure only Java 8 features (anonymous classes, simple loops) are utilized.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Validate that xmlns:android points strictly to http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android and activity elements are fully linked.

steps.title: Building Magic Spellbook
steps.description: Trigger final compilation and assembling of the Magic Spellbook debug binary using Gradle.
